content.title: RGEN Q3 Deep Dive: Robust Product Demand Offset by Margin Pressures and Guidance Reset
content.summary: Biopharma manufacturing company Repligen Corporation (NASDAQ:RGEN) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 21.9% year on year to $188.8 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $733 million at the midpoint came in 0.8% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.46 per share was 10.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
